result.reason: The operative language reaches the fallback: it creates a mutual cap based on 12 months of aggregate fees paid or payable and excludes indemnification, confidentiality breaches, gross negligence, and wilful misconduct from that cap. Fraud is also a playbook-approved carve-out. However, the redline retains a duplicated, incomplete paragraph beginning “10 LIABILITY RELATES,” making the clause unprofessional and potentially confusing. It also unnecessarily changes the measuring date from filing of the cause of action to the event giving rise to the claim. In addition, the consequential-damages exclusion remains carved out only for Section 8 rather than consistently using the new Excluded Claims definition, although the fallback does not clearly require all cap carve-outs also to be carved out from that exclusion.
